title: Story premise EDU069: The Paper Lands in One Inbox
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (home organization). Hook: Is this paper waiting for a decision, or already filed? Takeaway/theme: Separate incoming material from material that already has a decided place.
description: A resident wants to find a recent event flyer, but loose papers arrive on every surface. One incoming-paper tray separates unprocessed items from a small set of named destinations and makes the flyer findable.
